correctness.rationale: Independently regenerated the complete face set of 714 nonempty simplices in sizes (18,108,264,252,72), bounded at five arcs since any selected component is a vertex-simple path on six graph vertices. Built deterministic acyclic Hasse matching (337 initial pairs, critical dimensions 0:1,2:4,3:23,4:12). Independently searched each unique alternating gradient path and performed four legal cancellations, verified DAG acyclicity on all 2376 cover relations after every operation, leaving 341 matching pairs, critical one vertex, nineteen 3-cells and twelve 4-cells. Reconstructed all 31 oriented integral Morse critical boundary columns and verified zero. Since the 3-skeleton is wedge^19 S3, its π3≅H3 via Hurewicz, so the vanishing 4-cell degrees imply their nullhomotopic attachments and wedge^19 S3∨wedge^12 S4. This is a genuine integral homotopy deduction, not merely homology equality.
residual_risks: The finite gradient-path and boundary cancellation certificate is necessary for this homotopy statement.
No extrapolation to larger bicliques or equivariant homotopy types.

value.rationale: The smallest balanced complete 3-regular bipartite graph is a natural and symmetric test of bidirected multipaths, whose 2-cycles exclude naive comparison with oriented bicliques. Its mixed degree 3/4 *integral homotopy type* is stronger than Betti ranks, and the verified four-gradient-path certificate makes a substantive topological classification, not an arbitrary table entry.
